paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation

model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score over the average lagging value (AL) for four different models. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis, ranging from approximately 16 to 28, represents the BLEU score and is also linear. The first line, represented by a cyan circle marker and solid blue line, begins at approximately 19.2 on the y-axis at x=0, then rises to approximately 25.5 at x=6. The second line, depicted by a purple square marker and a magenta dashed line, starts at approximately 20 on the y-axis at x=0, and steadily increases to approximately 25.8 at x=6. The third line, shown as a black square marker and a purple dotted line, begins at approximately 18.5 on the y-axis at x=0, and increases to approximately 24.1 at x=6. Finally, the fourth line, represented by a red star marker and a red dashed line, starts at approximately 18.3 on the y-axis at x=0, then rises to approximately 26.1 at x=6.
